description: This file defines functions and constants related to creating and managing self-contained client configurations for the Kubernetes API server, specifically handling loopback client setup and address resolution.

methods.name: NewClientConfig
methods.description: Creates a new REST client configuration for the loopback client, setting host, TLS, and QPS parameters.

methods.name: NewLoopbackClientConfig
methods.description: Generates a loopback REST client configuration with a specified token and certificate, overriding the server name for SNI.

methods.name: LoopbackHostPort
methods.description: Parses the bind address to extract host and port, substituting loopback address if necessary.

methods.name: getLoopbackAddress
methods.description: Returns the IP address of the local loopback interface, or 'localhost' if unavailable.
